title: Boston Freedom Trail: What the Red Line Walks Past

personas.one_line: Been here forever, tells stories, and always tells you which parts are true.
Reads how a place is built and teaches you to read it too.
Who got to belong here, and what it cost them.
Measures what nobody else is counting, delighted by what she can't explain.

description: Ten stops the trail marks and two it doesn't — what's hidden in the buildings everybody photographs.
terrain: Flat, sidewalks and brick (cobblestones in North End)
accessibility: Fully accessible except cobblestones near Paul Revere House
